name: Fadi Kelada
tagline: Planning-tools consultant at Enedis | Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering
about: Power-systems engineer at Enedis, where I work on the network planning tools, with a PhD on the dynamics and stability of low-inertia grids dominated by inverter-based resources. I build open tools for stability analysis (G2ELin) and for teaching power systems (Omega Lab).

experience.title: Consultant, Technical Department (planning tools)
experience.details: Expert on the low-voltage network planning tools. Pilot of the project to redesign the planning calculation tools for 2032 (Projet refonte des outils de calcul).

experience.title: Doctoral researcher
experience.organisation: Grenoble Electrical Engineering Lab (G2ELab), Université Grenoble Alpes
experience.details: Small-signal stability and EMT modelling of low-inertia grids with high shares of inverter-based resources; grid-forming converter control. Author of G2ELin. 100+ teaching hours, 2 interns supervised.

experience.title: R&D Engineer (internship)
experience.details: Developing power-system electromagnetic transient (EMT) models and simulations in OpenModelica for reference grids incorporating HVDC and hybrid AC-DC networks.

experience.title: Intern on Energy Management
experience.details: Graduation project internship: led my team to develop new energy management solutions for air-conditioning systems. The project won first prize.

education.title: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering
education.organisation: Université Grenoble Alpes, Grenoble Electrical Engineering Lab (G2ELab)
education.details: Thesis: "Study of dynamics and stability in low inertia power systems with high penetration of inverter-based resources", defended on 24 September 2024. Supervisors: Prof. Nouredine Hadjsaid and Dr. Jérôme Buire.

education.title: B.Sc. in Energy & Renewable Energy Engineering

projects.name: G2ELin
projects.details: Open-access power-system linearization and EMT simulation tool: MATLAB/Simulink library and a Python port with a FastAPI backend and web interface, 530+ automated tests and MATLAB parity checks.

projects.name: Omega Lab
projects.details: Interactive course on electrical power systems, from RLC circuits to grid stability: 67 lessons with live simulations, in French and English.

volunteering.title: Catechism servant
volunteering.organisation: Coptic Orthodox Church of St Michael & St George, Villejuif
volunteering.details: Serve in the catechism service, and built Khedma, the servants' web app: classes, attendance, birthdays and weekly follow-up calls, in French and Arabic.

volunteering.title: IEEE Region 8 Student and Young Professionals (SYP)
volunteering.details: 12 months of volunteering; co-chaired the IEEE R8 SYP Congress held in Grenoble in 2024.

achievements.title: IEEE SYP R8 Congress Secretary
achievements.details: Co-chaired the IEEE R8 SYP congress held in Grenoble in 2024.

achievements.title: Best Energy Management Solution
achievements.details: Led my graduation project team to win first prize in Schneider Electric's undergraduate projects competition.

achievements.title: Scholarship Holder
achievements.details: Ranked first in my Bachelor's class; received a fully funded French government scholarship for my Master's and PhD.
